description: Start a bulk test script replay workflow to execute multiple test scripts.

fanOutChoice.description: Optional: followPolicy (default) runs each test case's runSettings records per its lane's fan-out policy; primaryOnly runs only the primary record; allNow runs every record at once

intervalSec.description: Interval in seconds (-1 for one-time / on-demand)

limit.description: Optional: limit number of test cases to replay

namePrefix.description: Optional: prefix for generated workflow names

repeatPerTestCase.description: Optional: repeat count per test case

testCaseIds.description: Optional: targeted test case UUIDs to replay

useCaseId.description: Optional: only replay test cases under this use case (UUID)

workflowParams.description: Optional workflow parameters for workflow-level overrides

llm.description: Model tier override. tier 'light' runs the Standard tier (Claude Sonnet 5.5, faster and lower cost); tier 'standard' runs the Premium tier (Claude Opus 5.5, the default). Omit to inherit the project/use case/test case setting.

maxRunTimeMs.description: Max runtime per workflow kind, in milliseconds (60000–3600000). The run fails as timed out once it exceeds this. Omit a kind to inherit the project/use case/test case setting, else its built-in limit.

enableEverMemOS.description: Override to enable/disable EverMemOS for this workflow run

enableSharedTestMemory.description: Override to enable/disable SharedTestMemory for this workflow run

name: muggle-remote-workflow-start-test-script-replay-bulk
